review_description: The initial sales and quoting process was great, although at times it felt like I was more knowledgeable than the sales consultant. Installation went well, but I discovered several weeks later that the team had left multiple tiles on my roof "pushed up" which resulted in water penetrating my roof space and leaking through into the house. Subsequently it was identified that the installers had cut into the fire barrier between the roof cavity and the concrete roof tiles, allowing ingress of water.I had several issues with my Fronius Wattpilot which kept disconnecting from my Fronius inverter, and Westsun Energy was very slow with their support response. They only offered assistance after I had contacted their office three seperate times by email as no one would answer their support phone.In the end, I had to factory reset both my inverter and Wattpilot by myself, and set them up again from scratch. I was disappointed to see that Westsun had assigned themselves as "Owners" on my system without my permission on the Fronius website, something which I had to contact Fronius directly to fix.Overall, I feel like I've spent too much money for this 6.6 kWh three-phase system, and I'm genuinely disappointed with the installation quality and after-sales support.

review_description: So I did a ton of research before selecting the company I wanted to do my solar install and I’m pleased I did. They were knowledgeable of all brands and knew their stuff.That alongside company security, their great reviews, the competitive prices, and just feeling comfortable without the pressure was a huge bonus for me.The install guys were fast, efficient and happy - even on a 39 degree day.And my sales guy was contactable day  after my install on helping me with the smart monitoring which I’m sure isn’t apart of his job so I’m extremely grateful.I’m very happy with choosing Westsun Solar, and would do it again!!

My experience with Westsun Solar was overall positive and the quote was competitive in comparison with the other 2 companies that I approached.The system design information Ben provided was clear, simple yet informative and heaps better than the other 2 companies that I approached.Dealing with Lisa in the office was smooth and the installers were prompt, polite and the work was of good quality. The guys only broke 5 tiles in total but swapped them all out so that the appearance of my roof remains as before.

We came into this not knowing very much at all about solar, and learned a lot thanks to SolarQuotes and all three of the companies that quoted for us. All three provided three strong quotes with good alternatives, but we had by that time decided what system to purchase – using the new Sunpower Maxeon 400 watt panels teamed with a Solar Edge optimised inverter – and two of them quoted on that. Westsun provided the better price and won the business.Their sales team were very helpful, and the office and installation teams very professional. A measuring team came around to check that the system could be fitted as per the quote, and my assumption was that there would be "contingencies" or issues that would change the price, but instead they confirmed what had been proposed, and set an installation date less than two weeks away. On the day the team turned up pretty much on time, worked hard all day, and by late mid-afternoon we had a solar system. It was much easier and more professional than I had hoped. The office staff had liaised with Western Power and Synergy, so the system went to work the same day with no glitches.The only disappointing factor was that for some reason Solar Edge have decided that they no longer support energy usage data for the user, so we can see what energy we are generating but not how much we are using or returning to the grid. Very, very annoyed with Solar Edge!
